name: com.catandling.nontoon
description: FORK of lilxyzw/NonToon 0.1.3 - custom build: NT-FIX 1-9 + lilToon-compatible lighting adjustment + per-material shade direction bias + mask channel inversion (1-R/G/B/A) + ShadowColor module (lilToon 1st/2nd/3rd shadow colour, now with lilToon's per-pixel Shadow Strength/Border/Blur masks) + Emission module (lilToon emission/blend mask) + SelfLight module (per-avatar private light with baked self-shadow; NT-FEAT 10 adds PCSS-style soft shadows, shadow density/clamp/distance and a receive mask in the spirit of nHaruka's PCSS4VRC, but with no realtime Light so the VRChat performance rank is untouched) + colour-temperature / match-ambient light tinting (Use Color Temperature, Color Temperature in Kelvin, Match World Light Color, Block World Ambient) + realtime self-shadow (PCSS from a self-rendered linear depth map, driven by the companion package's rig; 0.3.10 also ships the NTRTDepth shader that 0.3.9 accidentally left out of the zip) + MatCap VR stereo parallax + per-material Nearer toggle + full zh-Hans localisation (properties, tooltips, module headers, enum labels, ShaderLab-declared rendering/stencil properties). Pure shader library: the lilToon->NonToon material converter and the SelfLight baker live in the companion package com.catandling.nontoon-converter. Package id is com.catandling.nontoon. Shader names, module IDs and asset GUIDs are retained; remove the old package before installing this renamed fork.
